text:
support-alex: FYI customer (AcmeRetail) reporting latency tail spike this morning, p95 looks okay but p99 on their dashboard is +700ms vs baseline. They see errors sometimes 504 after long auth proxy retries. Escalating to oncall at 09:12 PT.

maria-oncall: ack. thread_ts=2945678901. Can you paste the customer's dashboard link and a sample request id?

support-alex: link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/acmeretail/latency
request id: req_0a3f9c2b

tim-sre: looking. Our global p99 shows a small bump but nothing that big. Dashboard aggregation for customer scoped view may be using sampled spans and a different quantile method. @oliver-observability can you check ingestion/sample weights for that org?

oliver-observability: checking ingest logs... I see a batch of traces from acmeretail around 08:58-09:05 with a lot of auth-proxy retry spans. Sample rate for traces was 1/10 for that tenant during heavy load. Ingest pipeline applies uniform sampling then downstream dashboard uses raw trace-derived quantiles (unweighted) while our metrics are histogram rollups from service metrics (weighted by requests). That can cause divergence.

maria-oncall: TL;DR we have two sources: metrics p99 (from ministats histograms) and trace p99 (sampled, unweighted) — customer is looking at trace panel. That explains larger tail. But need to confirm auth proxy retries are inflating trace latency.

oliver-observability: confirm. Example trace for req_0a3f9c2b shows auth proxy retry loop: `auth-proxy -> auth-proxy (retry1) -> auth-proxy (retry2)` adding ~420ms total. Also noticed some 504s from our auth-proxy with `upstream_timeout` in logs.

jen-infra: I see a deployment to auth-proxy at 08:50 by `fwd-deploy-bot` with a new retry/backoff change. SRE-bot rollout note: "auth-proxy:v2.14 -> v2.15 ramp 10%" around 08:50. Could be correlated.

sre-bot: Deploy event: auth-proxy:v2.15 ramp 10% at 2026-03-17T08:50:12Z. Health checks green.

tim-sre: Good catch. Hypothesis: v2.15 changed retry behavior (longer backoff) causing sampled traces to show big tails; metrics histogram uses request completion times excluding internal retries or counts retries differently. We should reproduce and mitigate.

maria-oncall: Repro steps for auth-proxy locally:
```
# emulate failing upstream with retries
curl -H "x-test-fail: 1" https://auth-proxy.svc.internal/test -w "\n%{time_total}s\n"
# run against v2.14 & v2.15
```

jen-infra: I'll spin a canary of v2.15 in staging and run that curl test.

oliver-observability: Meanwhile I'll add a trace-panel note that explains sampling and quantile differences, and add an overlay that shows request-count-weighted p99 from metrics to reduce confusion.

tim-sre: For immediate mitigation, suggest reverting retry backoff change for v2.15 rollouts to 0% ramp and route traffic away from canary.

jen-infra: Doing rollback now: `kubectl set image deployment/auth-proxy auth-proxy=auth-proxy:v2.14 --record` on canary. Kube shows new pods creating.

sre-bot: Rollout event: auth-proxy canary image set to v2.14 at 2026-03-17T09:04:03Z.

maria-oncall: Customer notified: "we're investigating, temporary mitigation applied (canary paused), monitoring for tail impact" :white_check_mark:

support-alex: Customer replied: thanks, will monitor. They asked for short-term query they can run themselves to compare panels.

oliver-observability: Provide this quick query for their dashboard: `metric_p99_requests{org_id="acmeretail"}` vs traces p99: `traces.quantile(0.99, service="api-auth", filter=org_id=="acmeretail")` with note: "traces are sampled; prefer `metric_p99_requests` for SLO-aligned numbers".

tim-sre: Action items:
- jen-infra: confirm rollback reduced retry latency in canary (due in 10m)
- oliver-observability: annotate dashboard panels + add tooltip explaining sampling vs metrics
- maria-oncall: follow up with customer in 30m with status
- tim-sre: file postmortem if we find root cause in v2.15 retry logic

jen-infra: Canary logs after rollback show average auth-retry latency back to baseline. Will keep watching.

oliver-observability: After rollback, sampled traces no longer show the consistent 400ms retry block in new traces. I'll add a short note on the dashboard and pin it.

maria-oncall: Customer updated: they see p99 back to normal in their dashboard as well, will confirm later.

tim-sre: Closing immediate escalations. Post-incident follow-ups: ensure trace-derived panels show sampling rate and consider storing sample-weights so that dashboards can compute weighted quantiles. Filing ticket: INF-4821.

sre-bot: Incident created: INF-4821 "trace vs metrics p99 discrepancy; auth-proxy retry change" assigned to tim-sre.

support-alex: Thanks team. I'll close the support ticket once customer confirms stable in 1h.

maria-oncall: Nice coordinated work. :tada:

tim-sre: note for PMs: changes to internal retry/backoff need a perf signoff for tail effects (cc @product-api)

oliver-observability: Adding docs update: how to interpret trace vs metric quantiles for customers (will link in ticket).
